text: Dream Finders Homes, Inc. is a NYSE 'controlled company': founder, CEO and Chairman Patrick Zalupski holds more than a majority of voting power through super-voting Class B shares, representing 84.4% of combined voting power. Among its Class A 5%+ holders, Kayne Anderson (13.0%) and BlackRock (12.8%) are the largest.

source.name: Dream Finders Homes, Inc. DEF 14A 2026 Proxy Statement (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: Mr. Zalupski, our President, CEO and Chairman of the Board, holds more than a majority of the voting power of our common stock
